purpose: First-party facts from the maker's own documents, compared against data/specs/singer-14cg754.json. Research input for the editor; not a spec file.

documents.note: Highlights, details, MSRP, two reviews. Shows Out of Stock and Sold out. States no weight, dimensions, stitch length, cutting width, needle, throat or motor figures.

documents.type: instruction manual (PDF, 30 pages), linked from the product page
documents.note: The file is titled SE017 INSTRUCTION MANUAL, not 14CG754. Its specification table lists 6.0 kg, 301 x 280 x 270 mm, stitch length 1.0 to 4.0 mm, LED light. Treated as a different model's manual, not as 14CG754 facts.

documents.type: operator's guide (PDF, 53 pages, third-party archive copy, OCR text layer)
documents.note: Cover reads 14SH744/14CG744 and 14SH754/14CG754 Operator's Guide, Part No. 364300-000L. Undated and hosted on archive.org, not on singer.com. Its specification table names 14CG754.

documents.type: warranty PDF linked from the 14CG754 product page
documents.note: SVP Worldwide Limited Warranty: 25-year product frame, 1-year parts and adjustments.
Lists tiers 25/2/90 day, 25/1, 25/5/1 and 1 year with eligible models. The 14CG754 is not named in the text retrieved.
Sibling comparison. Links the 25/2/90 warranty PDF and a model-specific 14HD854 manual.

facts.value: 1,300 stitches per minute (page highlight); 1,300 spm maximum (operator's guide)
2, 3 or 4 threads
Ratio 1:0.7 to 1:2.0 (operator's guide). The product page says differential feed is included and gives no range.

site.label: Differential feed
site.juki: Ratio 0.7 to 2.0 in the operator's guide; the product page gives no range.

facts.value: 1 to 4 mm (standard: rolled hemming F-2, ordinary overedge 3.0)
facts.note: Operator's guide gives 1 to 4 mm; the spec's 2.0 to 4.0 comes from the Amazon listing. The SE017 manual linked from the product page also says 1.0 to 4.0 mm. Product page gives no figure.

site.label: Stitch length
site.juki: 1 to 4 mm in the operator's guide; the product page gives no figure.

facts.value: Ordinary overedge stitch width 3.0 to 6.7 mm (standard 3.5); rolled hemming 1.5 mm
facts.note: The guide calls this overedge stitch width, and says the cutting width cannot be set below 3.5 mm for rolled hemming. The guide does not publish a separate cutting-width range.

facts.value: Singer needle Cat. No. 2022, sizes 80/11 and 90/14; a #90/14 needle set is furnished. The guide says Singer #2020 may be used in an emergency but may skip stitches unless tension is readjusted.
facts.note: No maker document names the ELx705 equivalence; that part of the spec rests on the parts retailer.

facts.value: 6.0 kg (13.2 lb) in the operator's guide
facts.note: Spec 13.5 lb is from the Amazon listing. The SE017 manual also says 6.0 kg, so the guide figure is not model-specific evidence either way. Product page gives no weight.

site.label: Weight
site.juki: 6.0 kg (13.2 lb) in the operator's guide; none on the product page.

facts.value: 338 x 280 x 265 mm wide, deep, high (13.3 x 11.0 x 10.4 in) in the operator's guide
facts.spec_value: 14 x 11 x 11.5 (17 high with the thread stand extended)
facts.note: Spec is from the Amazon listing, which is rounded and its dimension labels vary. Unit check: 265 mm is 10.4 in, not 11.5 in. Product page gives no dimensions.

facts.value: Product page does not state a stitch-type count; it says 2, 3 or 4 threads "for a variety of stitch combinations". The 14HD854 page says "6 different stitch types".
facts.note: Spec value 6 comes from an Office Depot listing. No 14CG754 maker page or document found states 6. The operator's guide lists stitches by thread combination, not as a count.

site.label: Stitch types
site.juki: No stitch-type count on the 14CG754 page; 2, 3 or 4 threads.
site.others: Office Depot copy says 6 stitch types.

facts.value: Built-in free arm (page highlight: "Free-arm sewing")
Built-in rolled hem (page highlight)
Color-coded lay-in thread tension (page highlight)
facts.spec_value: Color-coded lay-in threading with automatic tension release; manual looper threading
facts.note: Maker page does not mention automatic tension release; the spec's wording comes from a dealer.

facts.value: Electronic speed control (page highlight)
facts.note: Not a spec-file field. Motor type and wattage are not published.

facts.value: Operator's guide refers to a light bulb that must cool before it is changed. The product page lists no light. The SE017 manual says LED; the 14HD854 page says two LED lights.
facts.note: Light type of the current 14CG754 is not stated on its own page. Owners complain the light is dim (see claims and rollup).

facts.value: Not published. No needle-to-arm or workspace figure on the product page or in the operator's guide.
facts.note: Throat stays null. Guide gives needle bar stroke 27 mm and presser foot rise 4.5 mm, which are not throat figures.

facts.value: Presser foot rise 4.5 mm (operator's guide)
facts.note: Guide gives rise in mm for a lifter lever; treat as a figure for the guide's model family and verify against the PDF before use.

facts.value: Product page makes no frame or motor statement. The 14HD854 page claims a "heavy duty metal frame".
facts.note: Frame and motor stay null for the 14CG754. Amazon's detail table says Material: Metal, Plastic.

facts.value: Linked warranty PDF: Limited 25-Year (product frame, free replacement parts, owner pays labor) and Limited 1-Year (parts and adjustments, parts and labor free). Page text: "Up to 25 Years Warranty Coverage ... some restrictions may apply." Household use only.
facts.spec_value: 25 yr limited on machine head, 2 yr on motor, light, wiring, switches, speed control and electronics, 90 days on adjustments, belts, rings, bulbs and attachments
facts.note: The 25/2/90 tier is on Singer's coverage page and on the 14HD854 page (PDF named 25-2-90). The 14CG754 page links the 25-1 PDF and the coverage page text retrieved does not list the 14CG754. Amazon's listing says 25-year including 2-year electronic and 90-day labor. Model-specific on the product page link, so conflict is between the maker's own pages. Editor must decide wording.

site.label: Warranty
site.juki: Page links a 25-year frame and 1-year parts and adjustments warranty (household use).
site.others: Amazon and our spec say 25 years head, 2 years electronics, 90 days adjustments.

facts.value: The product page links a manual titled SE017, not 14CG754. A 14CG754 operator's guide exists as a third-party archive copy (Part No. 364300-000L) and a printed manual is sold by parts retailers.
facts.note: Page-vs-manual disagreement: figures in the linked SE017 manual (301 x 280 x 270 mm, stitch width 5.2 to 6.7 mm left needle and 3.0 to 4.5 mm right needle, LED light) differ from the archive guide for the 14CG754 (338 x 280 x 265 mm, overedge 3.0 to 6.7 mm, light bulb). Do not cite the SE017 manual as a 14CG754 source.

site.label: Manual
site.juki: The product page links an SE017 manual.
site.others: The 14CG754 operator's guide is an undated archive copy.

facts.value: MSRP $349.99; Singer listed $209.99 ("Save $140") with the page showing Out of Stock and Sold out on 2026-10-02
facts.note: MSRP is Singer's own comparison figure, not a selling price. Recorded as the page's wording only. The 14HD854 page shows MSRP $399.99, listed $319.99, also Out of stock in a search snippet.

facts.value: Page is live with "Out of Stock" and "Sold out"; it does not say discontinued or replaced. Page text: "Please note: Back-Orders will ship on TBD date".
facts.note: The spec's note that a dealer says the 14HD854 replaces the 14CG754 is not supported by any Singer page seen.

facts.value: Operator's guide accessories: needle set, small screwdriver, tweezers, spreader. Page lists no accessories.
facts.spec_value: All purpose foot, needle set, tweezers, spreader (2-thread converter), small screwdriver, thread nets, lint brush, foot control, power cord, instruction manual with stitch guide, machine intro DVD
facts.note: Guide supports four of the items; thread nets, lint brush and DVD are from a retailer and not confirmed by the maker.

facts.value: "Give all your projects a clean, store-bought look" and "professional results" (page copy); "Commercial Grade" does not appear on the Singer page; the page title uses ProFinish.
facts.note: Marketing wording only. Our spec already records "Commercial Grade" as a retailer name.
